thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/02/2018: AAPL, GPRO, OLED, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/02/2018: AAPL, GPRO, OLED, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.70%
AAPL: -6.48%
IBM: +0.53%
CSCO: +0.22%
GOOG: +0.34%
Technology stocks were trending higher early Friday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(-) Apple ( AAPL ), which was down by over 6% after CFO Luca Maestri said on a conference call late Thursday that the company will no longer provide unit sales data for its iPhone product starting with the December quarter.
(-) GoPro ( GPRO ) was declining by more than 13% as it booked a Q3 non-GAAP net loss of 6.1 million, or a $0.04 loss per share, swinging from a non-GAAP net income of $21.1 million, or $0.15 earnings per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter, but exceeded consensus estimates of a $0.06 loss per share.
(-) Universal Display ( OLED ) was down by more than 27% after it said the second-half is not progressing as expected, as it reported diluted EPS of $0.48 in Q3, up from $0.28 a year earlier, based on new accounting standard ASC 606. Using its previous method, EPS would have been $0.72 for the quarter.
